findings.excerpt: (TSLA) Q3 2026 deliveries slip 2% to 486,532, but beat estimates Fred Lambert | Oct 2 2026 - 6:11 am PT 66 Comments Tesla (TSLA) delivered 486,532 vehicles in the third quarter of 2026, down 2.1% from the record 497,099 it delivered in the same quarter last year. That’s still about 25,000 more than Wall Street expected, with the consensus at 461,974 deliveries.

supply_demand_durability.note: 搜尋摘要為二手轉述，未讀到可逐字複製的頁面原文，故僅放 clues。共識：2026 約 1.77M、2027 約 1.92M、2028 約 2.10M 輛（2026-09 底）；Q3 2026 交付 486,532 輛、較 Q3 2025 降 2%，高油價被多篇歸為短期推力；交付高於產量約 22,000 輛（庫存去化）；電池產能為量產瓶頸。未找到產業過剩/緊缺的結構性 vs 週期性直接分析。 線索 3 條，程式核實 1 條，2 條以搜尋摘要保留（未核原文）
